name: SNDL Inc.
verdict: FLAT — named kill: MARK-INTEGRITY (data-class). The SunStream Level-3 book (C$400.4M = ~91% of mcap) appreciates ONLY on FX ('primarily due to USD/CAD') across both H1 quarters while its only disclosed NAV driver is a borrower entering Chapter 15 (Cannabist); ex-FX the mark declined both quarters. Cash+mark gross ~US$1.65/sh vs $1.33 tape narrows to ~tape after ~US$117M lease liabilities. The mark, not the operating business, is load-bearing and unverifiable until the 40-F Level-3 note is read.
conviction: red 8/10 (kill case), blue 7/10 — blue VACATED red's headline H2-step-up kill on seasonality (H2'25 delivered +C$27.0M; FY26 needs +C$14.3M = 53% of prior-year actual — the III base-effect artifact); operating case is NOT the fight
kill_class_census: 3 NOVEL (fx-only Level-3 appreciation w/ Cannabist Ch.15; 280E-on-consolidation mechanism [magnitude unverified]; working-capital softness inside the self-defined FCF guide) / 2 CONSENSUS (segment contraction; buyback durability) / 1 OVERTURNED (H2 step-up)
audit_notes: Blue corrected red's share count (248.66M not 240.7M) and the 25%-discount loan buy over-read (motivated PE-fund seller of paper SNDL already holds 69.4% of — accretive purchase, not a third-party mark). Runway clean: C$183.2M cash, zero funded debt, buyback switchable — both benches refused a runway kill.
recourt_triggers: 40-F/interim SunStream Level-3 note read (inputs, discount rate, borrower-by-borrower, auditor CAM) — if majority senior-secured RE-collateralized <=60% LTV, FLIPS to 0.5% starter at 0.45x book
Parallel consolidation 6-K w/ standalone EBITDA + 280E cash tax (undated, conditional — copper lesson)

narratives: The 40-F note, when finally read, shows a clean senior-secured book — the discount was unearned all along and the flip-trigger fires only after a re-rate has begun.
Parallel consolidates smoothly with disclosed EBITDA and the market pays for the US platform before our dated gates admit us.
Reflexive: consumer-heat detectors show DECAYING on every banner — if that lane is measuring attention rather than demand, our own instrument biased us bearish.
premortem.sentence: If this ruling costs us, the most likely reason will be that we treated an unread valuation note as guilty until proven innocent while the market read the same silence as ordinary — and the flip-gate we designed opened after the move, not before it.
